topics.label: Introduction and Overview of Cancer Hallmarks
topics.groupedBecause: It introduces the lecture's objectives, historical framework, and stepwise model of cancer progression through hallmark functional properties.

topics.label: Growth Signal Autonomy and Signaling Pathway Deregulation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how oncogenic mutations in cell surface receptors and intracellular signaling cascades drive sustained proliferation and growth factor independence.

topics.label: Differentiation Block in Tumorigenesis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how cancer cells fail to exit the cell cycle and arrest in immature states across hematopoietic malignancies and intestinal carcinoma.

topics.label: Evasion of Apoptosis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains how cancer cells resist programmed cell death through mutations in p53 and the dysregulation of pro- and anti-apoptotic proteins.

topics.label: Replicative Immortality and Cellular Senescence
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how cancer cells overcome the Hayflick limit via telomerase reactivation and examine how normal stress signaling via p53 induces cellular senescence.

topics.label: Metabolic Reprogramming and Oncometabolites in Cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how cancer cells rewire their metabolism toward aerobic glycolysis and how metabolic enzyme mutations generate oncometabolites that alter gene expression.

topics.label: Tumor Angiogenesis and the Angiogenic Switch
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic addresses the requirement for new blood vessel growth to sustain tumor survival and describes the physiological balance of angiogenic regulators.

topics.label: Mechanisms, Dynamics, and Genetics of Metastasis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the metastatic cascade, the seed-and-soil hypothesis, clinical tracking via circulating biomarkers, and the clonal genomic landscape of metastases.

topics.label: Conclusion and Review of Cancer Hallmarks
topics.groupedBecause: It concludes the lecture with framing on the collective manifestation of cancer hallmarks and references to further reading and upcoming practicals.
